decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  01, 02 (Rev B), 03 (Rev D), 04 (Rev A), 05 (Rev A), 06 (Rev A), 07 23 January 2026,  08 Received:  22 December 2025.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side and rear elevations, and roofs, of the development hereby permitted.

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 5 - The replacement flat roof of the house's existing single storey rear extension to its two storey rear outrigger hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or amenity terrace at any time.  

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy in accordance with Local Plan Policies SC7 and CC2.

Condition : 6 - The window(s) to be fitted on the [front/rear] roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the [conservation area/listed building].
description: Erection of a rear roof dormer infill extension, second floor rear outrigger dormer extension, single storey rear infill extension and ground floor front infill extension, installation of two replacement front roof lights, replacement ground and first floor front sash windows, replacement first floor rear window with a Juliet balcony and alterations to the existing single storey rear extension, and removal of a first floor rear outrigger side window (with matching infilling) to the house.
